name: Bulwark
description: A shield for everything you publish. Every request is checked in microseconds against 250k+ blocklisted addresses and known attack payloads; attackers are banned on every tunnel at once. Its own dashboard shows every request in full, warns about waves of attackers before they peak, graphs the patterns, keeps your blocklist and reports attackers to the vendors that missed them. On by default; no slower tunnels.
author: Alexd Aero

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: Honest numbers: only strangers count as attacks, and nothing Bulwark stopped is left off the graph.
highlights: Addresses banned on a blocklist or by the lookups now show in Patterns ("known bad, nothing tried") instead of an empty graph
Your own signed-in traffic is never counted as attacks (a .php page of yours was a "probe")
Requests held for a check count as stopped, and get their own colour in the traffic chart
Mass-scanner and attack-tool patterns now appear in "Attack patterns over time"
Each overview card says what it counts: requests or addresses

actions.label: Stop
actions.confirm: The dashboard, lookups, waves and reports stop. The guard inside Burrow keeps enforcing bans and blocklists on its own.
